execution.discovery_trade_rule: Entry Monday must be >=2021-01-01 and exit Monday must be <=2024-12-31. Any position requiring 2025 price data is excluded and 2025 remains unopened.
execution.entry: Monday 00:00 UTC Binance Spot daily open, exactly 2 calendar days after Saturday cutoff
execution.exit: Next Monday 00:00 UTC Binance Spot daily open

immutability: No value in this contract may change after Discovery outcome execution. Any change requires a new prospective version and cannot rescue V0.1A.

block_bootstrap.method: circular moving-block resampling of chronological weekly records; recompute spread in each sample

metrics.directional_gross_trade_return: LONG: +r; SHORT: -r; FLAT excluded from trade metrics
metrics.max_drawdown: maximum peak-to-trough drawdown of compounded active-trade equity using base net directional returns
metrics.mean_median_profit_factor: computed on active directional net trade returns

newey_west.series: chronological base net directional active-trade returns
newey_west.t_stat: mean divided by HAC standard error of mean using Bartlett weights

metrics.profit_factor: sum(positive net active-trade returns)/abs(sum(negative net active-trade returns)); +inf if no losses and positive gains
metrics.single_week_dominance: largest positive base-net directional trade return divided by sum of positive base-net directional trade returns
metrics.top_bottom_gross_spread: mean(BTC simple returns on LONG weeks) - mean(BTC simple returns on SHORT weeks)
metrics.top_bottom_net_spread_base: gross spread - 2*0.001; two-leg sort spread, each leg pays frozen 10 bps round trip
metrics.top_bottom_net_spread_stress: gross spread - 2*0.002; two-leg sort spread, each leg pays frozen 20 bps round trip
metrics.year_dominance: largest positive yearly cumulative base-net directional PnL divided by sum of positive yearly cumulative base-net directional PnL
metrics.year_spread: within each Discovery year, gross top-bottom spread minus 2*0.001

mve0_operational_pass.btc_primary_only: BTC alone determines MVE-0. ETH is reported as confirmation and cannot rescue BTC.
mve0_operational_pass.stress_strongly_negative_definition: stress net top-bottom spread < -0.001 (-10 bps/week) is strongly negative

signal.history: Exactly 52 prior Saturday raw-growth observations, excluding current Saturday. Current week invalid unless all 52 prior values exist.
signal.supply_value: Exact UTC calendar-date SplyCur for USDT plus USDC; no interpolation or carry-forward.
